The '''Crystal Room''' was a located in the [[Teirra Parko]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Recardeon]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rimma]]. It contained artistic artifacts from Rimma's history. In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], several of the artifacts were damaged or destroyed when [[Jatz/Legends|Jatz]] musician [[Fitz Roi]] fired off his antique [[Slugthrower/Legends|slugthrowers]] while drunk.
